verdict.rationale: Gazebo ships official, first-party C++ libraries (gz-math, sdformat, gz-transport, gz-physics, gz-gui) that developers link into their own applications, plus a documented plugin API for extending gz-sim and vendor packages for building against Gazebo from ROS. That covers the core of building against official SDKs. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs or bindings beyond C++ (e.g., Python), in-depth API reference or SDK tutorials, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the developer experience.
